niche: online spiritual and shadow work courses
prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on whether you want **Jungian self-inquiry**, a **regular meditation practice**, or a blend. These are good starting points based on the available course information:

### Shadow work
- **[Encounters with the Shadow — Jung Platform](https://jungplatform.com/course/encounters-with-the-shadow)** — A structured introduction to Jungian shadow work, with video and audio lessons and a companion guide. A solid first choice if you want a psychology-oriented framework.
- **[Engage the Shadow — Jung Platform](https://jungplatform.com/course/engage-the-shadow)** — A broader, more practice-focused option featuring multiple experts and techniques. Better if you already know the basics and want exercises to try.
- **[Shadow Courses — Jung Platform](https://jungplatform.com/shadow-work)** — A collection of introductory and more advanced material, including courses on active imagination and relationships. Useful if you want to explore several angles.

### Spiritual practice and meditation
- **[Mindfulness Daily — Tara Brach and Jack Kornfield](https://courses.tarabrach.com/courses/mindfulness-daily)** — A 40-day online mindfulness training. A good choice for building a consistent meditation habit alongside reflective work.
- **[Mindfulness and Well-being: Peace In, Peace Out — Rice University Online](https://online.rice.edu/courses/mindfulness-and-well-being-peace-in-peace-out)** — A self-paced course if you prefer a more academic, secular introduction to mindfulness.
- **[Personal Enrichment — Naropa University](https://www.naropa.edu/academics/personal-enrichment/)** — Offers contemplative courses rooted in Buddhist traditions, including compassion practice and meditation. Consider this if you want a tradition-based approach rather than a general wellness course.

**A practical pairing:** Start with *Encounters with the Shadow* and a daily mindfulness course. Shadow work can bring up difficult emotions, so go slowly, pause if you feel overwhelmed, and consider working with a licensed mental-health professional if you have significant trauma or distress. Course certificates are generally not the same as clinical qualifications.
